title: Game of one-upmanship? Why INDIA bloc has hit the streets 4 days in a row
content: In New Delhi, opposition leaders have rallied for four straight days, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. They charge the government with manipulating electoral rolls while staging protests across multiple sites. Police responses have fluctuated, at times permitting rallies and occasionally enforcing strict measures. Adding to the unrest, a youth-led organization is planning a demonstration on October 10, potentially escalating tensions and influencing the opposition's future tactics.

title: Rahul's claim that Prez Murmu accepted 'vote theft' allegation incorrect: Report
content: Regarding the President's response during their interaction, Rahul Gandhi had said, "I sat in quite an unbelievable meeting. First, we took a memorandum to the President of India. In that memorandum, we clearly stated that the Prime Minister, HM Amit Shah, and CEC Gyanesh Kumar had conspired to destroy Indian democracy. The President in no way denied what we said, questioned what we said, or argued what we said."

title: Global warming could make Russia richer. It could also bring Nato closer to its doorstep
content: As the Arctic warms, Russia faces both opportunities and significant challenges regarding its environment and infrastructure. The Northern Sea Route is becoming a vital transit corridor, potentially boosting Russian exports to Asian markets. However, increased traffic raises risks associated with accidents and environmental harm. Despite potential economic benefits, Russia must contend with severe infrastructure damage from permafrost thaw.

title: Texas neighbours fought over 5-foot strip; court upholds easement
content: A dispute between Texas neighbours over a five-foot strip of land near Lake Conroe reached an appeals court after disagreements over utility meters, drainage and property access. The court upheld the Amadors' right to use the neighbouring land for home maintenance and repairs while also confirming a $100 trespass award in favour of the Suitts.

title: Hope springs eternal as West Indies pull off highest chase in T20Is in Ranchi
content: Hope and Sherfane Rutherford turned the match on its head with a 120-run stand for the fourth wicket. Rutherford smashed 84 off 37 balls, while Hope remained unbeaten on 102 off 45 as the West Indies chased down India's 250-run target with nine balls to spare.

title: Florida reverses course, approves 4,800 apartments and 1,000 hotel rooms
content: In a surprising turn of events, Orange County commissioners have given the green light to the Tuscana land-use plan, previously halted due to environmental issues. Set to introduce numerous apartments and hotels, this development raises alarms among locals about flooding and wildlife conservation in the vulnerable Shingle Creek Basin. Activists and residents are now rallying to influence upcoming elections, aiming to protect their community's environment.

title: Val Kilmer turned 5,328-acre New Mexico ranch into retreat, then sold most of it
content: In 2011, Val Kilmer’s scenic Pecos River ranch in New Mexico changed hands after years on the market. Initially listed at $33 million, the asking price dropped to $18.5 million. The ranch not only boasted abundant natural beauty and guest facilities but also held a storied connection with Hollywood. Eventually, it was acquired by Texas oil tycoon Benjamin A. Strickling III and his wife, concluding Kilmer's chapter with the property.

title: How Jensen Huang's $30M to Stanford University helped open engineering centre
content: In 2010, Jensen Huang and Lori contributed to establish the Jen-Hsun Huang Engineering Center at Stanford University. The center was designed for collaboration among engineering, science, and medicine students and researchers. It features laboratories, workshops, and a library to support academic pursuits and innovation. Stanford’s administration emphasized the importance of interdisciplinary work in modern engineering education. This initiative reflects a commitment to advancing future innovations and research.

title: Archaeologists drill 60 feet into Mount Ararat site in Noah’s Ark search
content: Archaeologists investigating Turkey’s Mount Ararat have drilled the boat-shaped Durupinar formation for the first time, collecting hundreds of soil samples from depths of up to 60 feet. Researchers are examining organic matter and possible traces of ancient wood for clues linked to Noah’s Ark, but laboratory analysis is still needed before drawing conclusions.

title: Match-winner on captaincy debut! Farhan leads Pak to stunning chase vs Sri Lanka
content: Sahibzada Farhan made a remarkable debut as captain, scoring 89 runs and guiding Pakistan to an impressive win over Sri Lanka, successfully chasing down 183. The aggressive pairing with Maaz Sadaqat shone through, sealing victory with seven balls left in the first T20I. Sri Lanka had set a competitive stage, thanks to Lahiru Udara's 91 runs. The anticipation builds for the upcoming matches scheduled in Rawalpindi.

title: Tom Brady’s $375M Fox deal: How is he building his sports empire?
content: Tom Brady invested in a soccer team, purchased a WNBA team, owned a minority stake in the NFL’s Las Vegas Raiders, is volleyball his next sports franchise business venture? Beyond his $375 million broadcasting deal, he is slowly infiltrating every sports field to build his own massive sports empire. How far will he go? We cannot wait to know.

title: FGTeeV Duddy’s family controversy: What did he say during Instagram Live?
content: FGTeeV Duddy sparked concern after calling his family “the devil” and “demons” during an Instagram Live. He later said those comments did not reflect how he sees his children. Roblox creator KreekCraft said the family wanted the videos removed and asked viewers to give them privacy. The situation has drawn widespread attention across social media as the family handles events.

title: 2026 bypoll results: Vijay’s TVK sweeps Tamil Nadu, BJP wins Bengal, Assam
content: In Tamil Nadu, it was still “Thalapathy” Vijay and his TVK brigade making their presence felt. In West Bengal and Assam, the BJP strengthened its position by winning with big margins. Puducherry, meanwhile, remained firmly with CM N Rangaswamy's ruling AINRC. Tamil Nadu and West Bengal went to bypolls in two assembly constituencies each, months after their assembly elections brought new parties to power in both states.

title: 149.5kmph thunderbolt! Mayank Yadav leaves West Indies reeling in chase
content: India scored their highest-ever T20I total against West Indies, reaching 249 runs in 20 overs. Mayank Yadav played a critical role by taking three wickets during the powerplay. His impressive bowling performance included a remarkable delivery clocked at 149.5kmph. West Indies struggled to respond and were left reeling early in their chase.

title: 'This govt will fall': Rahul's 'guarantee' to allies amid protests against CEC
content: Addressing INDIA bloc MPs at the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan, Gandhi said the issue went beyond Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and called for the termination of the current government. "There is a much deeper problem than Gyanesh Kumar and it requires termination of this current government," said Congress leader Rahul Gandhi.

title: California cyclist, 73, rides 3,200 miles and raises $740,000 to fight child hunger
content: Mark Strauss embarked on an incredible 3,200-mile cycling journey over 69 days to support the No Kid Hungry initiative, raising an impressive $740,000 toward a target of $1 million. Along the way, he connected with numerous supporters and gained insight into the pervasive issue of childhood hunger in America. His endeavor highlights the ongoing need for accessible food resources for children, as the campaign continues its vital fundraising efforts.

title: India smash highest T20I total vs WI as Samson, Iyer and Tilak go berserk in Ranchi
content: India showcased their batting prowess against the West Indies, amassing an unprecedented T20I total of 249 runs. The highlight of the match was Sanju Samson, who electrified the crowd with an explosive 82 runs from 41 balls. Significant input from Ishan Kishan and Shreyas Iyer, alongside Tilak Varma's not-out 44, fortified India's position.

title: Gauhati HC grants bail to singer Amritprava Mahanta in Zubeen Garg death case
content: The Gauhati High Court has granted bail to Amritprava Mahanta, marking the first instance of bail being awarded in the case related to Zubeen Garg's tragic death. Bail was set at Rs 50,000. Garg, a prominent figure, passed away in a scuba diving incident in Singapore in September 2025, just days before his scheduled performance. In the wake of this, Shyamkanu Mahanta, the organizer, has also faced arrest.

title: Steve Smith leapfrogs Steve Waugh in Australia's all-time Test run-scorers list
content: Smith now has 10,945 runs from 224 innings in 126 Tests. Waugh scored 10,927 runs in 260 innings across 168 Tests during his 19-year career for Australia.

title: Railways lose appeal over Rs 1.45 lakh payout for stolen bag
content: Delhi state consumer commission upheld an order requiring Northern Railway to pay Rs 1.45 lakh to Ajoy Kumar. Kumar's luggage was stolen from a reserved train coach while traveling from Delhi to Patna. Railway officials failed to prevent unauthorized entry into the coach. The commission found negligence by railway staff contributed to the theft and delayed FIR registration.

title: George Michael secretly paid for woman’s IVF; she gave birth two years later
content: In 2010, George Michael secretly paid for Jo Maidment's IVF treatment after watching her discuss her struggle to conceive on television. Two years later, she gave birth to daughter Betsy. A bouquet of flowers and a card revealed the singer's identity. Maidment publicly shared the story in 2017, following his death.

title: ‘We could have broken more records together’: Kuldeep’s heartfelt message to Chahal
content: In a candid interaction, Kuldeep Yadav opened up about his feelings on surpassing Yuzvendra Chahal's T20I wicket tally. While proud, he wishes to collaborate with Chahal for more unforgettable records. Reflecting on his adaptation to T20 cricket post-hiatus, Kuldeep outlined his game plan for the West Indies, emphasising control and limiting aggressive strokes. Ultimately, he remains focused on the collective success of the team over individual achievements on the field.

title: Jantar Mantar stir: Govt to shut internet for 24hrs within 4km radius in New Delhi
content: Senior Delhi Police officers on Friday also held a high-level meeting at the police headquarters to review the law-and-order situation ahead CJP's proposed protest at Jantar Mantar. The meeting focused on assessing the security situation and reviewing arrangements to maintain law and order in the national capital, they said. Officers also examined recent observations made by the Supreme Court, which are expected to feature in the discussions, sources added.

title: 'POSH is not a Chinese act': Sacked JNU professor alleges 'witch hunt'
content: Angomcha Bimol Akoijam, a Congress MP, was dismissed from JNU after allegations of sexual harassment emerged. The dismissal followed an inquiry where the Internal Committee recommended a major penalty based on the complaints. The allegations alleged inappropriate behavior during classes and interactions with students, leading to significant controversy. Akoijam referred to the dismissal as a potential exposure of a 'witch hunt' against him.

title: Sanju Samson matches Virat Kohli’s record with whirlwind fifty against West Indies
content: In the thrilling second T20I against West Indies, Sanju Samson showcased his batting talent with a blistering fifty, equaling Virat Kohli's record for the fastest fifty by an Indian against this rival. This explosive performance helped propel India's stellar powerplay score in T20Is. Teaming up with Abhishek Sharma, he set a strong foundation for India, continuing their successful momentum after a prior victory in the series.

title: CAFE III kicks in from 2027: Will your next car be cheaper to run?
content: India is set to implement new Corporate Average Fuel Economy norms from April 2027, aiming to enhance fuel efficiency. Automakers will face stricter fuel-consumption targets and incentives for clean technologies, which may impact vehicle prices. Buyers must consider total ownership costs, including maintenance and energy, before purchasing new cars. The regulations will promote various technologies like electric and hybrid vehicles while allowing manufacturers to choose their paths.

title: South Carolina couple started HVAC firm with $2,000; revenue now set to top $8m
content: A South Carolina couple started an air-conditioning business with just $2,000 after losing their jobs in December 2020. Stephanie and David Postell founded Anchor Heating and Air in 2021, dividing responsibilities between operations and technical services. Nearly five years later, their company is on track to generate more than $8 million in annual revenue.

title: China restaurant owner gifts two employees BMWs worth Rs 43 lakh each
content: In a heartwarming gesture, a restaurant owner in Jiaozuo, China, gifted BMW cars to two dedicated employees struggling with their daily commutes. Ma Yanli, keenly aware of their challenges in tough weather conditions on electric scooters, chose to offer substantial rewards as a recognition of their hard work and commitment. The surprise left the employees overwhelmed with gratitude, showcasing that prioritizing employee well-being fosters a thriving business culture.

title: Hyderabad’s common mobility pass fails to hit the mark
content: Priced at ₹8,500 a month, the new pass allows unlimited travel on Metro Rail and RTC buses within the ORR limits but excludes MMTS and last-mile services. Commuters say affordable fares, feeder connectivity and coordination among transport agencies are essential for seamless travel

content: Increased enrolment, enhanced attendance, no complaints of hunger and more energy among students throughout the day were some of the key factors that emerged as focal points in the Telangana schools after the introduction of the breakfast scheme this academic year, according to a survey in Kodangal constituency by Third Vision Research and Services
